name: Ornate Passageway
desc1: This wide stone passage is carpeted with a luxurious red fabric. The
desc2: walls are covered in a variety of tapestries, showing ancient beasts,
desc3: dwarven kings, and epic battles with a variety of foes. Here and there
desc4: a statue of an armoured dwarf stands like a sentry. A large archway
desc5: leads out to the east, and the passage continues to the north.
